name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2100: Eight tabs, their HD art and the clock all fit one row at his 1120 window. The tab strip was never the problem: four layers set its padding and the last was an !important pair in a SECOND stylesheet, so every responsive rule written where the header is styled lost silently. Folded to one source (as v1276 did for chips), then sized the concessions cheapest-first - tabs tighten, gaps tighten, date drops under the time, and only below his window does the icon yield.
